title: Classical mechanism fed nihilism, and quantum ontology reverses it

statements.text: A science based on classical mechanism shaped a view of the human condition that led to nihilism and existentialism and to treating consciousness as an epiphenomenon and freedom as a fiction. The centrality of consciousness in a quantum ontology calls for reconsidering that view.

sources.quote: led to nihilism and existentialism in late 19thcentury Europe
